# Bundled export dependencies

- **jsPDF 4.2.1** — `resources/assets/jspdf.umd.min.js`, MIT. https://github.com/parallax/jsPDF
- **svg2pdf.js 2.8.1** — `resources/assets/svg2pdf.umd.min.js`, MIT. https://github.com/yWorks/svg2pdf.js
- **DejaVu Sans** — unmodified font bytes in `resources/assets/export-font.ttf` and `resources/assets/export-font-bold.ttf`, Bitstream Vera font license with public-domain DejaVu changes. https://dejavu-fonts.github.io/

License notices for these projects and the npm runtime dependencies accompany this file. The prebuilt UMD distributions are included without source modifications. No CDN or external conversion service is needed for export. Runtime assets are served from the same authenticated LibreNMS plugin routes.

The MorMap logo was supplied by the user and is included unchanged. The generic hardware stencils are original MorMap artwork. OS/vendor icons are read from the installed LibreNMS assets; their original terms still apply.
